R1.description: A worker's checkpoint verification runs only the tests the plan names for that checkpoint plus the repository-wide guards, never the full suite

R2.description: The full suite is CI's: at most one local run, at the self-review, never in a review-fix pass, and two full runs never overlap (a documented rule)

R3.description: The rule is pinned by a test and recorded with its trade-off and its two open decisions
